question.text: For how many days must the draft offer document for a public issue of debt securities be kept open for public comments?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.228-p.229, after filing the draft prospectus or draft shelf prospectus with the stock exchanges, the document is to be made available to the public for comments for a period of 7 days. The Trap: The other periods (14, 21 or 30 days) are not the prescribed public comment window for a draft prospectus/draft shelf prospectus of debt securities under the SEBI framework. Note: The 7-day public-comment window is part of the disclosure process for public issues of debt securities.
